title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, syllabus map and answer technique (all categories)
Know the exam format and question styles; know the seven syllabus categories and their weights; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official ITIL Foundation (Version 5) syllabus, version 5.0 (February 2026)

toc.title: The seven categories and their weight

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Questions 40, all multiple choice, 1 mark each
Time 60 minutes (75 if the exam is not in your native or working language)
Pass mark 26 of 40 (65%)
Negative marking None, so always answer
Book Closed book
Thinking level Bloom level 1 and 2: recall and understanding
Level Foundation; it is the entry point to the higher ITIL (Version 5) qualifications
Exam tip

. The exam tests definitions and understanding, not hands-on skill. If you can say what a term means and tell it apart from a similar term, you pass.

Old wording ITIL 4 Foundation was the earlier exam. Version 5 replaced it, so use Version 5 names: ITIL Value System, ITIL Product and Service Lifecycle (eight activities), digital product and service management.

2The four question styles

Style What you see Tip
Standard A stem and four options Find the keyword in the stem first
Negative The stem says NOT or EXCEPT Rare; rewrite it as "three are true, find the false one"
Missing word(s) A sentence with [ ? ]; pick the word(s) Read the sentence aloud with each option
List Four numbered statements; pick the option naming the two correct ones Judge each statement true or false, then match the pair

List questions are never negative: exactly two statements are correct.

3The seven categories and their weight

# Category Weight Marks
1 Key ITIL terms and definitions 30% 12
2 The four dimensions of product and service management 10% 4
3 The ITIL Product and Service Lifecycle 10% 4
4 The ITIL Value System (principles, governance, value chain, practices, improvement) 40% 16
5 Value stream identification, mapping and management 5% 2
6 ITIL and AI 2.5% 1
7 ITIL and other frameworks (DevOps, PRINCE2) 2.5% 1

Exam tip

. Categories 1 and 4 are 70% of the marks. Spend most of your study time on key terms and on the ITIL Value System.

4How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line of the stem and find the keyword.
  2. Name the term in your head before you look at the options.
  3. Eliminate options that describe a different term.
  4. Choose the option that matches the definition, not the one that merely sounds modern or helpful.
  5. Never leave a blank; there is no penalty.

Common traps: output vs outcome, utility vs warranty, customer vs user vs sponsor, problem vs error vs known error, continuous delivery vs continuous deployment.

5A four-week study plan

Week Modules Goal
1 1 to 4 Key terms, value, dimensions
2 5 to 7 The eight lifecycle activities
3 8 to 11 Value System, principles, practices, improvement
4 12 to 15 Value streams, AI, other frameworks, mock questions

Re-read the Quick Reference Card at the end of each module, and do the Exam Q&A the next day.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Northwind Bank asks how many questions it must answer correctly to pass the ITIL Foundation (Version 5) exam. Which answer is right?

  • A26 of 40
  • B20 of 40
  • C30 of 40
  • D35 of 40
Show the answer

Answer: A. The pass mark is 26 of 40, which is 65 percent.

S2A candidate is unsure about a question and has 30 seconds left. What should the candidate do?

  • AAnswer it, because there is no negative marking so a guess costs nothing
  • BLeave it blank, because wrong answers lose marks
  • CSkip it, because blank answers are scored as half a mark
  • DAsk the examiner for a hint before the time ends
Show the answer

Answer: A. There is no negative marking, so an answer can only help.

S3In a List question, which statement is true?

  • AAll four statements are correct
  • BExactly one statement is correct
  • CExactly two statements are correct
  • DThree statements are correct and one is false
Show the answer

Answer: C. List questions have two correct statements, and they are never negative.

S4Which two categories together carry 70 percent of the marks?

  • AThe four dimensions, and the lifecycle
  • BKey terms and definitions, and the ITIL Value System
  • CValue streams, and ITIL and AI
  • DITIL and AI, and ITIL and other frameworks
Show the answer

Answer: B. Key terms (30 percent) and the Value System (40 percent) together make 70 percent.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam, and what is the extra time for a non-native language?

Show the answer

60 minutes; 75 minutes in total (25 percent extra).

R2What Bloom levels does the exam use?

Show the answer

Level 1 (recall) and level 2 (understanding).

R3Name the four question styles.

Show the answer

Standard, Negative, Missing word(s) and List.

R4Which category has the highest weight?

Show the answer

The ITIL Value System, at 40 percent.

R5Is the exam open book?

Show the answer

No, it is closed book.

R6What replaced ITIL 4 Foundation?

Show the answer

ITIL Foundation (Version 5).

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 40 questions, 60 minutes, 26 to pass, no negative marking, closed book
Styles Standard, Negative (rare), Missing word(s), List (two correct)
Weights 30 / 10 / 10 / 40 / 5 / 2.5 / 2.5 percent
Method Keyword, name the term, eliminate, choose the definition
Never leave a question blank
